Topic 2 · 04:00–14:00 (and on into the silent stretch)

Twenty-two pages of specs, read out loud.

The network's media kit arrived as a PDF over chat and was walked through page by page. These are the numbers the creative has to hit — several of them tighter than the team's own kit was built to.

15 MBbanner video ceiling
3 MBstatic banner ceiling
500 MBin-stream video ceiling
87characters of headline, maximum
📅

From the earlier call. This page comes from the 5 October planning call, three days before the advertising call that makes up pages 01–08. It is kept here so the campaign reads as one record. Where the two calls disagree, the later one stands and the change is noted on the index.

The limits

File sizes are the constraint nobody designs for

Read straight off the kit during the call, and repeated on every banner page.

Banner formats

Display

  • Video: MP4, MPG, AVI — max 15 MB
  • Static: JPG, GIF, PNG — max 3 MB
  • Footer desktop 950×250, mobile 300×250
  • Header mobile 305×99 and 300×100
  • Interstitial mobile 300×250
  • Full-page interstitial 320×480

Video and native

In-stream and native

  • In-stream: MP4, MPG, MOV, AVI, WMV — max 500 MB
  • 16:9, 1080p, 5–30 seconds
  • Shorties: same types, 500 MB, 9:16
  • Native: 640×360, desktop and mobile
  • Native rollover video — 15 MB
  • Headline max 87 characters, brand text max 25
📏

Two text limits that affect copywriting, not production. Native placements cap the headline at 87 characters and the brand text at 25. Nothing in the creative kit was written to those limits, because the kit was built for banners where the text is baked into the image. If native is ever bought, every headline needs re-checking against a character count.

The format nobody costed

Homepage takeover

Flagged on the call as the premium option and then left alone.

What it is
The whole homepage

A homepage skin plus every visible ad spot on the homepage. Desktop and mobile.

The catch
Pornhub only, and no price

Unlike the banner pages, it carries no dimensions, no file limits and no rate. A format you have to ask about — and nobody did.

The full catalogue

Every format on the network, in one list

The public ad-formats page was opened later in the session, after the audio had already stopped. It is the same catalogue the account manager walked through on 8 October.

🔗

Each format lists the sites it runs on — Pornhub, RedTube, Tube8, YouPorn — and the verticals it accepts, which include Adult Games, Adult VOD, Apps/Games, Cams, Dating, Financial Services and Male Enhancement/Nutra. Gambling is not named in any tag list on this page, which is worth knowing before a compliance conversation.

What was built against these specs

The kit was already under the limits — a different set of them

The creative kit was reviewed in the same session. It was built to its own caps, which are tighter than the network's.

The kit's own cap
1 MB for video units

The 320×480 pre-roll is 463 KB and the 300×250 is 322 KB, both far under the network's 15 MB banner ceiling. The delivery list reads 462 KB for the same file — a rounding difference in the kit's own two pages.

And for stills
300 KB image cap

Stated on the masters page: "Every unit under the guide's 300 KB image cap." Against a 3 MB network limit.

The mismatch
Built for a tighter brief

The kit is engineered for a guide roughly ten to fifteen times stricter than the network requires — 1 MB against 15 MB for video, 300 KB against 3 MB for stills. Safe, but quality was given away for no reason.

Worth checking
Is the 1 MB cap ours or theirs?

If it is a self-imposed guide rule, the video units could be re-exported at far higher quality within the network's actual limits.

🔢

The delivery page states two counts. The file list says "55 files, 41.4 MB uncompressed"; the download link says "52 files (33.9 MB)". A three-file gap between what is listed and what the zip actually contains. Probably the layered green/blue variants, but it should be reconciled before anyone treats the zip as the complete delivery.
